synopsis: Fraunhofer IESE is described as providing modular co-simulation and fault injection through FERAL, with driving-simulator integration also reported [f16115, f8825]. Its FERAL demonstrator combines CARLA with other engineering components through connectors, in an automotive demonstration [f8710, f8826]. These descriptions establish a reported tool capability and on-road example, but an off-road adaptation was not found [f8825, f8826, f8827]. The expert-opinion capability account lacked a located primary page, and the off-road search likewise located no primary page, leaving a verification gap for off-road planning [f8825, f8827].

relations.note: Both attribute modular co-simulation and fault injection to Fraunhofer IESE.
Both describe FERAL combining CARLA with other components; details differ.
The connector-based demonstrator exemplifies the reported integration capability.
The located demonstration is automotive; an off-road adaptation was not found.
